jobs.description_text: Role Summary You are an autonomous AI Consultant, responsible for creating the harness for designing and building the AI harness, agent framework, and reusable engineering components required to operate a modern data platform based on Apache Iceberg , Trino , and Parquet . Your primary responsibility is not only to build data pipelines, but also to establish the agentic execution framework (AI Harness) that enables multiple specialized agents to collaborate, execute tasks, maintain state, orchestrate workflows, and deliver end-to-end data engineering capabilities. Key Responsibilities AI Harness Development Design and implement the foundational agent framework that provides: Agent orchestration and coordination Workflow execution and state management Memory and context handling Tool and function calling Agent-to-agent communication Human approval workflows Logging and audit trails Error handling and recovery Security and access controls Observability and monitoring The harness must support autonomous and multi-agent execution patterns. Specialized Agents Creation The agents will need to perform the following: Discover Iceberg catalogs and schemas Profile datasets Generate metadata and lineage Ingest data from databases, APIs, files, and streams Create Parquet datasets Register and maintain Iceberg tables Generate Trino SQL Build transformation workflows Create curated and business-ready datasets Validate schemas and data integrity Detect anomalies Generate reconciliation reports Analyze Trino workloads Recommend partitioning strategies Optimize Iceberg tables and Parquet files Classify sensitive information Manage metadata and lineage Apply retention and compliance policies Monitor pipelines and agent activities Detect failures and bottlenecks Generate alerts and operational insights Expected Deliverables Iceberg table definitions and schemas Trino SQL scripts and views Python data pipeline code Data quality validation suites Metadata and lineage documentation CI/CD deployment artifacts Monitoring and observability configurations Technical documentation and runbooks Skills and Experience The candidate should demonstrate expertise in: Experience with Generative AI, Agentic AI, or LLM-based solutions. Proficiency in Python, including FastAPI, Pydantic and Pandas. Experience designing and implementing AI Harness or multi-agent frameworks. Hands-on experience with LangChain & LangGraph. Experience with Apache Iceberg, Trino, and Parquet-based lakehouse architectures. Experience building data ingestion, transformation, and orchestration pipelines. Strong knowledge of metadata management, data lineage, and data governance practices. Experience developing REST APIs, SDKs, and reusable engineering frameworks. Experience with observability, monitoring, tracing, and operational support practices. Strong understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and microservices patterns. jobs.description_text: We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer specialising in Generative AI, RAG, and agentic AI to design, develop, and deploy production-ready AI solutions. You will build and enhance GenAI-powered voice bots and chatbots using AWS services such as Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, and Amazon Connect, integrating MCP tools, knowledge retrieval pipelines, and AI guardrails. With strong Python engineering skills and a focus on security, performance, and scalability, you will work closely with client-delivery teams to deliver innovative, enterprise-grade AI solutions across NCS’s growing portfolio. What You'll Do Build and launch Architect and ship production-ready GenAI applications using LLMs, RAG and agentic AI. Create voice bots and web chatbots with Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, Amazon Connect and related AWS services. Engineer RAG pipelines end to end: document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval and response generation. Orchestrate agentic workflows and MCP integrations for secure tool calling, API connectivity and multi-step task execution. Configure AI agents with Bedrock AgentCore, adding tool integration, memory, identity and observability. Choose the right foundation models by weighing response quality, latency, cost and deployment needs. Design conversations that flow naturally, with multi-turn interactions, context management, fallback handling and smooth handover to human agents. Bring voices to life by integrating speech-to-text, text-to-speech and streaming where needed. Build backend services and REST APIs with Python, FastAPI, Flask, AWS Lambda and Amazon API Gateway. Apply ML and NLP techniques such as classification, regression, entity extraction, text processing and summarisation where they add value. Protect and prove Safeguard every response with Amazon Bedrock Guardrails and application-level controls against hallucinations, prompt injection, harmful outputs and unsupported answers. Protect Client data with PII detection and redaction, access management and data residency compliance. Craft evaluation frameworks that measure accuracy, relevance, groundedness and retrieval quality, using tools like RAGAS, DeepEval or promptfoo. Stress-test AI applications and integrations through functional, integration, regression, performance, security and end-to-end testing. Write clean, modular, testable Python, backed by Git, code reviews and automated testing. Run, refine and scale Keep a close eye on production performance, diagnose failures and lift response quality, retrieval accuracy, latency, reliability and cost efficiency. Instrument everything with logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards and alerting via Amazon CloudWatch and other observability tools. Automate deployments across environments with CI/CD pipelines, Docker and AWS deployment services. Pinpoint and resolve issues across LLMs, RAG pipelines, MCP tools, Amazon Connect, AWS services, APIs and backend integrations. Fine-tune prompts, retrieval strategies, model selection, context use and tool execution for better results at lower cost. Collaborate and grow Partner with architects, developers, QA, DevOps and Client stakeholders to turn business needs into AI solutions that work in the real world. Document solution architecture, agent workflows, MCP integrations, API specifications, test and deployment processes, operational guidelines, and experiment results, clearly and concisely. Keep your finger on the pulse of GenAI, agentic AI, RAG, MCP, foundation models and AWS AI services, and bring the best new ideas to Team NCS. What You Bring Experience and education 2–5 years of hands-on experience in AI/ML engineering or data science. 2–3 AI/ML projects delivered beyond notebooks, ideally involving application integration, deployment, production support or ongoing optimisation. 1–2 GenAI applications built and deployed, such as RAG chatbots, LLM integrations, AI agents or enterprise knowledge retrieval. Production-oriented GenAI work in Python, connecting LLMs to APIs, external tools, databases or enterprise systems. Technical skills Strong Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow), with a habit of writing modular, testable, production-ready code. Hands-on command of GenAI concepts: LLM APIs, foundation models, prompt engineering, structured outputs, context management and tool calling. Experience with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock or Azure OpenAI (or equivalent). Sound judgement on RAG architecture: chunking strategies, embedding model selection, vector store configuration and retrieval quality evaluation. Practical experience with at least one vector database (Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector or equivalent). Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP) for model training or deployment. Proficiency with Git, CI/CD basics and Docker. Fluency in at least one more language (TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Go, or advanced SQL). What Will Make You Stand Out Voice AI experience with a pro-code approach (Twilio, Amazon Connect, Deepgram, Whisper + TTS pipelines). This is a significant differentiator. Exposure to agentic patterns such as tool-calling agents, ReAct loops, multi-step planning or reflection mechanisms. Familiarity with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex or similar frameworks. Experience with RAG and GenAI evaluation frameworks (RAGAS, DeepEval, promptfoo). Knowledge of responsible AI: bias detection, fairness metrics and output guardrails. Exposure to NLP pipelines: entity extraction, text classification and summarisation. Experience in an SI, consultancy or multi-client delivery environment. What We're Looking For in a Person You are a T-shaped professional: broad across AI/ML, software engineering, and data, with deep expertise in at least one area of AI engineering (e.g., LLM application development, classical ML at scale, or NLP). You are intellectually curious, rigorous about evaluation, and care about shipping things that actually work in production — not just in notebooks. Why NCS? Work on real, production AI systems — not sandboxed experiments. Your code ships to government agencies, financial institutions, and enterprise clients across APAC. Learn from a practice of 20+ AI engineers and data scientists with deep expertise spanning ML, GenAI, agentic AI, and cloud-native architecture. Accelerate your career: NCS invests in structured mentorship, certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP), and a clear seniority path from engineer to architect. Gain early exposure to cutting-edge agentic AI and voice AI projects that few engineers at your level will encounter elsewhere in the market. What can a career at NCS offer you?
